name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (gfx render). Accurately reflects body: renders the class-PROMOTION candidate grid (portrait + char name + current job + promotion arrow + target job). No Ghidra address residue. Caller fd2_promote_member_select_loop @ 0x311DC and use of fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry + FDTXT sprite 0x251 (promotion icon) confirm the promotion (not revive) semantics already captured in the plate.
purpose: Render the class-promotion candidate grid: up to 3 visible characters in a single column, each row showing portrait + char name + current job + a promotion arrow icon + the target post-promotion job.
logic_summary: Computes blink_frame from the chapter-intro dialog subframe counter (0,1,2,3 -> 0,1,2,1). Caps draw_count at min(candidate_count,3). For each visible row iter: char_idx = candidate_idx_list[scroll_offset+iter]; blits a 24x24 blink-variant portrait via fd2_tile_blit_24x24_with_dialog_bg_fill at dst=(iter*0x1A+0x75)*0x140+surface_offset+0x0E; picks border_glyph 0xC9 if (scroll_offset+iter)==highlight_idx else 0xCD; then emits four FDTXT labels at text_col=surface_offset+(iter*0x1A+0x79)*0x140 via fd2_display_dialog_scene -- char name (page char_id+1, +0x28), current job (page job_id+0x96, +0x82), promotion icon (page 0x251, +0xAF), and target job (page promo_entry[0]+0x96, +0xEF) where promo_entry=fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry(promotion_target_list[scroll_offset+iter]). Reads runtime_char fields char_id/job_id. No writes to globals.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid(uint32 candidate_count, uint32 surface_offset, uint32 highlight_idx, uint8 *candidate_idx_list, uint8 *promotion_target_list)
